attributes.additional_details: Reversal of the funding remit governing the City Bridge Foundation effectively restoring its primary operating framework to the traditional standards enforced prior to the 1995 legislative changes when core purpose of this historic fund was strictly dedicated to the maintenance and support of London’s bridges. We urge the trustees to re-prioritise the foundation’s historic mandate to save Londons bridges.
attributes.background: City Bridge Foundation should honour its original, centuries-old charter and restrict its primary financial focus to the upkeep of all London’s key river crossings.

rejection.details: Decisions about City Bridge Foundation’s funding priorities are the responsibility of its trustee, the City of London Corporation, rather than the UK Government or Parliament.
